# A page that gives nothing away

The container's own account owns /home/node/.npmrc. Reach the maintainers at
ops@example.invalid. The sample monitor is 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
and the loopback the tests bind is 127.0.0.1. Issue alexander-po/cronheart-node#1
is this repository's own.

The routing key is the integration key PagerDuty shows, and a Teams workflow URL
carries its signature in sig=, so routing_key: the key from that page.
Pass it as --routing-key <key>, or set routing_key to it.

routing_key: 'a'.repeat(32)
routingKey: 'a'.repeat(32)
PAGERDUTY_ROUTING_KEY=00000000000000000000000000000000
ROUTING_KEY_2=deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef
cronheart channels create --routing-key 00000000000000000000000000000000
'routing_key' => 'abcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcab'
{ "integration_key": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" }
{ "password": "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx" }

exports.CHANNEL_ROUTING_KEY_KINDS = CHANNEL_ROUTING_KEY_KINDS;
exports.CHANNEL_SECRET_KINDS = CHANNEL_SECRET_KINDS;
